answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks: bind every identity to a refundable stake bond, so forging a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds. The network reads a periodic pulse of each agent's verified, countersigned work, and reputation hardens slowly like carved marble rather than being minted free. A cheap, copper-plated clone has no deep ledger history to show, so sybil swarms stay shallow and get pruned before they can earn or vote.
